transcript.answer: Otto's conversations started surviving an api restart on 2026-09-30. Issue #296 made `apps/api` compose HAL Engine's `MongoSessionStore`, which keeps conversations in MongoDB, and it was closed that day at 10:25 UTC. Before that, `server.ts` created the engine without a session store, so the in-memory default lost every conversation on restart. I took the date from when #296 closed. I did not find a separate record of the merge or deploy.

judgements.reason: The answer gives the correct date of 2026-09-30 and the essential change of composing HAL Engine's MongoSessionStore in place of the in-memory default; it omits the commit hash and version but contradicts nothing.
